# 2026-11-19 v6.6 D3 phase 3 (the Black Sea trading posts: events 20-24, the actions oe_col_open_post and oe_col_close_post, the building oe_col_emporion) added to this file by the same generator.
# 2026-11-20 v6.7 D3 phase 4a (the Roman colonia: oe_col_found_colonia, events 30-31) added to this file by the same generator.

# BYZ scope. The empire is quiet enough to resettle land: it holds Constantinople, no civil war (vanilla or the 1341 / 1352 lines), no crisis of the vassal line (as C4's oe_glh_byz_calm).
oe_col_calm = {
    location:constantinople = { owner ?= c:BYZ }
    in_civil_war = no
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw_active }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cw2_active }
    NOT = { var:oe_vas_stage ?= 2 }
}

# Location scope. Old Roman land: one of the 39 historical regions, a former province of the outer circle, or reclaimed land still waiting to be settled.
oe_col_old_land = {
    OR = { has_variable = oe_theme_region has_variable = oe_tw_former_province has_variable = oe_trc_pending }
}

# Location scope. Reclaimed land (the reclaim track's marks): chosen first.
oe_col_reclaimed = {
    OR = { has_variable = oe_trc_pending oe_trc_settled = yes }
}

# Location scope. Vanilla's raid modifiers are on it.
oe_col_raided = {
    OR = { has_location_modifier = looted has_location_modifier = recovering_from_raids }
}

# Location scope. Sparse land that may take settlers: Byzantium's own (owner and controller), land, not Constantinople itself nor Mount Athos (r15), old Roman land, and thin (under oe_col_sparse_pop thousand people), raided, reclaimed, or not mainly Orthodox; and not resettled in the last 20 years (oe_col_cd).
oe_col_sparse = {
    owner ?= c:BYZ
    controller ?= c:BYZ
    is_land = yes
    NOT = { this = location:constantinople }
    NOT = { this = location:mount_athos }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_cd }
    oe_col_old_land = yes
    OR = {
        population < oe_col_sparse_pop
        oe_col_raided = yes
        oe_col_reclaimed = yes
        NOT = { dominant_religion = religion:orthodox }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Some sparse land exists.
oe_col_has_sparse = {
    any_owned_location = { oe_col_sparse = yes }
}

# Location scope. In great region 1, Thrace (historical regions 1-4).
oe_col_in_thrace = {
    OR = { var:oe_theme_region ?= 1 var:oe_theme_region ?= 2 var:oe_theme_region ?= 3 var:oe_theme_region ?= 4 }
}

# BYZ scope. One of the two migration slots is free.
oe_col_slot_free = {
    OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_s1_loc } NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_s2_loc } }
}

# BYZ scope. The action (and the AI's yearly roll) may start a resettlement.
oe_col_can_resettle = {
    oe_col_calm = yes
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 2 }
    gold >= oe_col_cost_in
    oe_col_slot_free = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_act_cd }
    oe_col_has_sparse = yes
}

# Location scope. Albania, northern Greece or the Morea.
oe_col_albanian_lands = {
    OR = { area = area:albania_area area = area:northern_greece_area area = area:morea_area }
}

# Location scope. Great region 6, eastern Anatolia (historical regions 27-37).
oe_col_east_lands = {
    has_variable = oe_theme_region
    var:oe_theme_region >= 27
    var:oe_theme_region <= 37
}

# Any scope. The imperial bloc holds land in Albania, northern Greece or the Morea.
oe_col_g1_bloc = {
    OR = {
        area:albania_area = { any_location_in_area = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
        area:northern_greece_area = { any_location_in_area = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
        area:morea_area = { any_location_in_area = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Steppe riders may come: the Golden Horde's great troubles (C4's global oe_glh_troubles = 1, or vanilla's horde civil war), or the imperial bloc holds land on the steppe.
oe_col_g2_ok = {
    OR = {
        AND = { has_global_variable = oe_glh_troubles global_var:oe_glh_troubles = 1 }
        AND = { country_exists = c:GLH c:GLH = { has_active_disaster = disaster_type:horde_civil_war } }
        region:steppes_region = { any_location_in_region = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Armenians may come wherever: the imperial bloc holds land in the Armenian highlands or Cilicia, or Armenian Cilicia has fallen (from 1375).
oe_col_g3_bloc = {
    OR = {
        area:armenian_highlands_area = {
            any_location_in_area = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
        }
        area:cilicia_area = { any_location_in_area = { has_owner = yes owner ?= { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } } }
        AND = { current_date >= 1375.1.1 NOT = { country_exists = c:CIL } }
    }
}

# Country scope. Genoa or a subject of Genoa (Gazaria in 1337).

# Location scope. Trade at this site is shut for now: Tana and Caffa under the embargo of 1343 (C4's global oe_glh_embargo) unless the empire chose to trade on (oe_glh_embargo_side = 2); Caffa while it is at war (Crimea's global oe_crm_caffa_war). A post here is suspended, a new one cannot be asked for.
oe_col_site_shut = {
    OR = {
        AND = {
            OR = { this = location:tana this = location:kaffa }
            has_global_variable = oe_glh_embargo
            NOT = { c:BYZ = { var:oe_glh_embargo_side ?= 2 } }
        }
        AND = { this = location:kaffa has_global_variable = oe_crm_caffa_war }
    }
}

# Location scope. Tana and Caffa once Gazaria has fallen (Crimea's global oe_crm_fall, set by its phase 4): a post there is lost and none can be opened again.
oe_col_site_fallen = {
    OR = { this = location:tana this = location:kaffa }
    has_global_variable = oe_crm_fall
    global_var:oe_crm_fall >= 1
}

# Location scope. A post can still be opened here when the host has agreed: it has an owner outside the imperial bloc who is not at war with us, and no post yet.
oe_col_site_can_open = {
    has_owner = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post }
    owner ?= { NOT = { is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } NOT = { oe_heg_byz_bloc = yes } }
}

# Location scope. The action (and the AI) may ask for a post here: oe_col_site_can_open, the site's cooldown over, trade not shut, Gazaria not fallen; a host on Genoa's side only once D1 has its books (oe_itp_on) and the Galata chain is not running (design 3.5.2).
oe_col_site_ok = {
    oe_col_site_can_open = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_cd }
    NOT = { oe_col_site_shut = yes }
    NOT = { oe_col_site_fallen = yes }
    NOT = {
        AND = {
            this = location:alexandria
            has_global_variable = oe_emd_alexandria
            global_var:oe_emd_alexandria = 1
            current_date < 1371.1.1
        }
    }
    OR = { NOT = { owner ?= { oe_col_genoese = yes } } c:BYZ = { has_variable = oe_itp_on oe_itp_gal_running = no } }
}

# Location scope. A post that counts: open and not suspended.
oe_col_post_counts = {
    has_variable = oe_col_post
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_susp }
}

# Location scope. A post that pays upkeep: it counts and the site is not our own port.
oe_col_post_pays = {
    oe_col_post_counts = yes
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_own }
}

# Location scope. 'A thriving post' may come here: level 1, open 120 months, paying (not suspended, not our own port), the host's opinion of us at least 20, not asked in the last 10 years.
oe_col_post_thr_ready = {
    var:oe_col_post ?= 1
    oe_col_post_pays = yes
    has_variable = oe_col_post_since
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_post_thr_cd }
    oe_col_since_m >= 120
    owner ?= { opinion = { target = c:BYZ value >= 20 } }
}

# BYZ scope. A new post may be asked for (action and AI): the action is open, the empire calm, 2 authority, no request under way, fewer than 6 posts on foreign soil, the City not blockaded (C7's oe_byd_running), the price at hand, a site to ask for.
oe_col_post_can_ask = {
    has_variable = oe_col_c_open
    oe_col_calm = yes
    international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { var:oe_pillars_authority >= 2 }
    NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_req_loc }
    oe_col_posts_open_n < 6
    oe_byd_running = no
    oe_col_post_can_pay = yes
    oe_col_any_site_ok = yes
}
